title: Sphinx gallery image scraper
body:
Add a custom sphinx-gallery scraper for PNG files.

The scraper includes all PNG files generated by a particular block from an example.

We can use this to generate files using povray.

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
Upon inspection I can no longer find anything wrong with the image scraper.

I recall that some image wasn't generated, for whatever reason --- but it generates both the one it's supposed to and a few in the NEB tutorial, and I cannot tell that it should generate any others.

Maybe there was a mistake last time (e.g. looking in wrong directory or what do I know).

@SianK Can you find anything broken?  We could also merge and see if things work as expected.  (I would remove the image scraper example, which is really just a test for our own benefit, before merging)

comments.author: SianK
comments.body: Nice work. I added povray rendering to gallery/nanoparticle and it works. We can also keep the python example for the image scraper - up to you. Ready to merge.

comments.author: askhl
comments.body: THanks a lot @SianK!  Setting to automerge after removing the temporary example.
